reasons: authorization supplied its own dependency and input maps instead of consuming runner trust roots
there was no durable success publication protocol
inner segment stacking lacked an explicitly out-of-sample anchor surface
peer and bounded-context implementations differed from the design
segment-model and proposal parameters lacked prospective authority

out_of_sample_anchor_surfaces.rule: Each of the three registered Round-B seed models is trained through the exact frozen v2 fit_end_inclusive, then predicts a buffered gap surface and the later inner validation surface. Only central-shelf proposals whose full maximum-bank support remains inside the gap are used to train the segment classifier. No anchor prediction used as a segment-model input is in-sample.
out_of_sample_anchor_surfaces.central_shelf_formula: C0=anchor_fit_end_inclusive+7 days+10 minutes; C1=inner_validation_start-7 days; retain proposals with start>=C0 and end_exclusive<=C1
out_of_sample_anchor_surfaces.maximum_context_support_rule: For H=max(context bank)<=168h, every retained proposal must satisfy support_start<=start-H and end_exclusive+H<=support_end_exclusive, where support_start is the first 10-minute row after fit_end and support_end_exclusive equals validation_start.

segment_training_and_outer_rule.inner_training: For each inner window, train segment models only on that window's OOS calibration proposals and evaluate only on its later OOS validation proposals.
segment_training_and_outer_rule.inner_selection: Pool validation-proposal precision across all three inner windows for each fixed cell; apply the frozen threshold and cell selection exactly once.
segment_training_and_outer_rule.outer_training_corpus: After inner selection is frozen, each outer-fold segment model is trained only on the three OOS central calibration-shelf proposal pools for the selected bank. Inner validation labels remain selection-only and outer labels remain evaluation-only.
segment_training_and_outer_rule.outer_validation_anchor: Use the already frozen fold-specific p100 event_day_balanced_binary_lgbm probability and postprocessed prediction; do not refit an outer anchor.

bounded_target_free_proposal_contract.surface_isolation: Every rolling statistic, two-sided score, proposal flank, and feature flank is computed only within the supplied OOS surface and one exact-cadence station-layer segment. It never crosses a gap, station, layer, surface boundary, or purge boundary.
bounded_target_free_proposal_contract.robust_channel_per_context: For each temperature and salinity channel and each declared context h, compute a centered rolling median and 1.4826*MAD over at most h*6 rows with min_periods=6; robust_z=(x-median)/max(MAD,1e-6).
bounded_target_free_proposal_contract.bounded_two_sided_cusum: Within each exact-cadence segment and declared context h, take max(abs(trailing rolling sum robust_z/sqrt(count)), abs(leading rolling sum robust_z/sqrt(count))); each side uses at most h*6 rows and min_periods=6.
bounded_target_free_proposal_contract.physical_score: max across registered channels and contexts of abs(robust_z) and bounded two-sided CUSUM, divided by 6 and clipped to [0,1]
bounded_target_free_proposal_contract.peer_contract: Only I-ORS and S-ORS may use a same-station, same-time, other-layer leave-one-layer-out median residual. G-ORS has the fixed univariate fallback. Other-station peers are prohibited.

paired_bootstrap.unit: positive connected event or normal station-layer KST day

evaluation_closure.decision_gates: exactly the unchanged v1 scientific design RESEARCH_GO, SUBMISSION_GO, preferred, and stretch gates
evaluation_closure.incumbent_fallback: If the candidate fails any gate, the scientific decision is RESEARCH_NO_GO and the frozen Round-B anchor remains the only retained model. No candidate file is generated.

execution_integrity.result_manifest_and_terminal_publication: temp write, file flush, create-only publish, directory flush while lock exists; lock unlink is the last success commit operation
execution_integrity.windows_unlink_durability_limit: Windows exposes no portable directory-fsync guarantee for deletion. All artifacts and directories are flushed before lock unlink; failure to unlink retains the lock and fails closed.
